title: VCoT-SQL: Enhancing Text-to-SQL Generation through Dual Chain-of-Thought Validation Training
abstract: arXiv:2611.00815v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Open-source LLMs provide a flexible alternative to closed-source models for Text-to-SQL but still struggle with complex queries. Finetuning with chain-of-thought (CoT) data improves reasoning, yet standard datasets lack CoT annotations, requiring synthetic generation. Existing synthesis methods only verify the final answer, allowing flawed reasoning steps to corrupt the training data. We propose VCoT-SQL, a framework that improves Text-to-SQL generation through intermediate-step validated CoT supervision and a dedicated SQL validator, which enables small open-source models to outperform frontier closed-source models. VCoT-SQL trains two complementary models on curated reasoning traces: an SQL generator using clause-level CoT templates where reasoning steps are verified via execution and schema alignment checks, and an SQL validator using diagnostic CoT templates to detect syntactic, semantic, and type level errors. translated_title: VCoT-SQL：通过双重思维链验证训练增强Text-to-SQL生成
translated_abstract: 开源大语言模型为Text-to-SQL任务提供了闭源模型的灵活替代方案，但在处理复杂查询时仍然表现不佳。使用思维链（CoT）数据进行微调可以改善推理能力，然而标准数据集缺乏CoT标注，需要进行合成生成。现有的合成方法仅验证最终答案，导致有缺陷的推理步骤会污染训练数据。我们提出VCoT-SQL，这是一个通过中间步骤验证的CoT监督和专用SQL验证器来改进Text-to-SQL生成的框架，使小型开源模型能够超越前沿闭源模型。VCoT-SQL在经过筛选的推理轨迹上训练两个互补模型：一个SQL生成器，使用子句级CoT模板，其推理步骤通过执行和模式对齐检查进行验证；一个SQL验证器，使用诊断性CoT模板来检测语法、语义和类型级别的错误。我们进一步设计……
tldr: VCoT-SQL框架通过中间步骤验证的思维链监督训练SQL生成器和SQL验证器两个互补模型，使小型开源模型在Text-to-SQL任务上超越前沿闭源模型。
en_tdlr: VCoT-SQL is a framework that trains complementary SQL generator and SQL validator models with intermediate-step validated chain-of-thought supervision, enabling small open-source models to outperform frontier closed-source models on Text-to-SQL generation.
